newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: Daewoo Elec sets 60 mln SFR convertibles.
newsitem.headline: Daewoo Elec sets 60 mln SFR convertibles.

text.p: Daewoo Electronics Co Ltd, a unit of South Korea's Daewoo Group, will issue a 60 million Swiss franc convertible bond on Thursday, Daewoo Securities, a co-lead manager of the issue, said on Tuesday.

A Daewoo Securities spokesman said the bond would be convertible into shares of Daewoo Electronics between June 16, 1997 and December 15, 1999. The conversion price is 5,609 won, a premium of eight percent.
The bond, which matures on December 31, 1999, would carry a yield to maturity of 45 basis points over the LIBOR swap rate.
Payment is due by May 27. CSFB Securities is the other co-lead manager of the issue.
Proceeds will be used to redeem Daewoo Electronics' overseas convertible bonds issued in 1994 and for investment abroad.
